identification: Heinrich Handwerck / Simon & Halbig German bisque socket-head doll, head size 3 1/2, sleep eyes (glass eyes loose in a bag), open mouth, pierced ears, ginger mohair wig, composition ball-jointed body supplied in pieces (unstrung, loose limbs, elastic). Late 19th/early 20th C. Photo 1 is the whole box; photo 2 is the back of the head showing the incised mark.

viewing_check: Hold the head to the light for hairlines at the rim, ears and eye sockets. Check the 3 1/2 mark matches the body (body marked 10 would be odd). Check torso neck and limbs for breaks. Count parts: four limbs, torso, spare eyes. Only worth bidding if a complete, original body is there and the price stays tiny.
